metadata.description:
The International Court of Justice (ICJ), the principal judicial organ
of the UN, holds public hearings on the preliminary objections raised by
Germany in the case concerning Alleged Breaches of Certain International
Obligations in respect of the Occupied Palestinian Territory (Nicaragua v.
Germany) from Monday 7 to Thursday 10 September 2026 at the Peace Palace
in The Hague, the seat of the Court. Session held under the
presidency of Judge Iwasawa Yuji, President of the Court.
